# Leftover Box / 반찬함

> A leftover-dish log: name, cooked-on, eat-by. Eat the oldest first. Not a fridge barcode inventory.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://leftover-box.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (localStorage key leftover-box:items:v1). No accounts, no server-side storage.

This is NOT FridgeBuddy, eggg, pecco, a SKU inventory, an AI recipe app, or a nutrition tracker.

## Pages

- [Home](https://leftover-box.try-dabble.com/): Add leftover name + dates, eat oldest first, eaten history, export/import
- [Privacy](https://leftover-box.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://leftover-box.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/leftover-box): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Dish name (required), cooked-on date, eat-by date (default cooked-on + 3 days)
- Optional location: fridge / freezer / other
- Optional one-line note
- Open leftovers sorted by eat-by soonest
- Days-left / today / overdue badges
- Mark eaten (keeps a short eaten history)
- Edit and delete
- JSON export/import
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with network-first service worker
